description: A CC BY 4.0 open lesson containing four units, 96 practice problems, 96 fully worked solutions, synthetic teaching data, and independently verified results. Units 12-15 extend Volume 1 into categorical outcomes, rank-based comparisons, quasi-experimental evidence, and single-case designs.
title: Psychology Statistics Practice Materials with Jamovi, Volume 2: Categorical, Rank-Based, Quasi-Experimental, and Single-Case Evidence
